keywords.def: the qualities of a letter's sound (singular sifah)
strong: the sound stops at once

questions.q: Read «يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا» (84:11) and name the quality of the د.
questions.a: د with sukoon is shiddah and jahr, so it bounces: yad'oo.

questions.q: Sifat sort (pupil PDF): sort 12 letters into strong, in between and flowing. Today's rota group recites 84:6 to 10 in turn.
questions.a: Strong: ق ط ب د ك ت; in between: ل ن م ر; flowing: س ش.

questions.q: Extend: write the shiddah phrase and the tawassut phrase.
Stretch: why does ك not bounce, though it is strong?
questions.a: ك is hams: the breath flows out, so it is released with breath, not a bounce.
A) ن. ن is in لِنْ عُمَرْ. ب is strong (shiddah); س is flowing (rakhawah).

questions.q: Think again: Say 'ab' and 'as' and hold the end as long as you can. Which one can you hold? Why?
questions.a: 'As' flows (rakhawah); 'ab' stops at once (shiddah). Some letters sit in between, like 'al'.
